title: Stabilize the public component API contract
description: Define the public API rules for typed Askama components: naming, builder patterns, htmx attrs, HTML escaping and trusted slots, error handling, feature flags, and semver expectations. Acceptance: README and AGENTS document the contract; component constructors follow one consistent pattern; examples show safe attrs and safe inner HTML slots.
notes: Askama integration research: prefer exported Rust component types plus HtmlSafe over asking consumer crates to import template macro files from this crate. Askama macro/import/include paths are resolved at the deriving crate's compile time through that crate's template dirs, so dependency-crate macro files are awkward for crates.io consumers. Useful supported patterns: templates-in-templates with nested Template values; implement askama::filters::HtmlSafe for wavefunk component types so consumers can render {{ component }} without |safe; use call-block macros only inside this crate's own templates/gallery; expose public helper functions/newtypes for safe asset links and htmx attributes; use block/blocks for internal partials, not as the cross-crate API.

title: Add owned or streaming DataTable API
description:
AllowThem's wavefunk-ui migration exposed repeated downstream allocation churn when rendering list pages: consumers often build parallel Vec<String> columns plus Vec<Vec<DataTableCell>> only to satisfy DataTableRow<'a> borrowed cell lifetimes. This is visible in AllowThem binaries/saas/dashboard/views.rs and binaries/standalone/views.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Provide a wavefunk-ui table API that lets consumers build rows without parallel lifetime-storage vectors, for example an owned DataTable variant, row builder, or streaming/render_into helper.
- Preserve the current borrowed DataTable API for semver compatibility.
- Keep explicit trusted-HTML boundaries for cells that render markup; plain text cells must remain escaped.
- Add examples/tests showing dynamic String-backed rows and HTML cells without self-referential storage.
- just fmt, just test, just clippy, and cargo package --allow-dirty pass.

title: Serve embedded assets without per-request byte copies
description:
AllowThem's wavefunk-ui migration mounts wavefunk_ui::axum::asset_router() for shared CSS/JS/fonts. A reviewer found src/axum.rs currently returns asset.bytes.into_owned(), which copies borrowed rust-embed bytes on every request. Fonts are roughly 116 KB and 38 KB, and CACHE_CONTROL currently forces revalidation.

Acceptance criteria:
- axum asset responses avoid extra allocation/copy for borrowed embedded assets; owned debug assets may move without an additional clone.
- Existing content-type behavior and path traversal protections are preserved.
- Cache semantics are reviewed for shared crate consumers; either stronger immutable/long-lived cache headers, ETag/Last-Modified support, or a documented revalidation rationale is implemented.
- Tests cover successful asset response headers/status and not-found behavior.
- just fmt, just test, just clippy, and cargo package --allow-dirty pass.
